messages:
aisha: Heads-up — started seeing ~30% span loss in traces for requests routed to gpu-pool-apac around 2026-03-16T14:12Z. Missing runtime spans (kv-cache, seq-manager) which is causing downstream SLOs to show noise. Noticed right after the egress policing change yesterday.

frank: Can you paste any exporter/collector errors?

aisha: Logs:
```
[2026-03-16T14:12:34Z] WARN otel-collector: failed to export spans: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = transport: connection closed
[2026-03-16T14:12:34Z] ERROR otel-collector/queue: push failed, queue_full
```

maria: PromQL I'm watching: `sum(rate(otel_exporter_spans_failed_total[5m])) by (zone, pod)` — spike pinned to apac-gpu-* pods starting 14:12. Also `otel_exporter_queue_length` jumped.

liam: Ops team also reported proxy-egress queuing/backpressure. ipvs conntrack metrics show drops. Could be that the gateway/proxy is closing connections under new egress caps and the collector's OTLP exporter is losing in-flight batches.

aisha: Observed that `traceparent` exists at ingress but is missing when spans reach the collector/gateway in some cases. Example header captured at edge: `traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01` — then later not present in requests forwarded to otel-gateway.

frank: Two vectors: 1) exporter errors + queue full cause spans to be dropped (internal runtime spans are first to go); 2) proxy/gateway might strip certain headers when it retries or re-proxies. Which proxy are we using in front of the collector? nginx-lb?

aisha: nginx-ingress + a sidecar L7-proxy in front of otel-gateway. nginx had `proxy_buffer_size` defaults and keepalive settings unchanged.

maria: Short mitigation suggestions:
- increase otel-collector replicas from 1 -> 3 to increase export capacity
- raise exporter queue size / receiver queue_size in collector config
- set exporter retry/backoff params to handle transient egress errors (`initial_interval`, `max_interval`, `max_elapsed_time`)
- ensure fronting proxies preserve `traceparent` / disable header normalization on retry
- add Grafana panel for `otel_exporter_queue_length` and `otel_exporter_spans_failed_total` to the gpu fleet dashboard

liam: Quick commands for mitigation:
```
kubectl -n observability patch deploy otel-collector --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":3}]'
# nginx patch to keepalive/proxy buffers
kubectl -n ingress set env daemonset/nginx-ingress-controller PROXY_BUFFERS=32k
```

frank: Also check SDK sampling config — runtime sdk sampling is 0.1 for user traces but internal runtime spans should not be sampled away. Confirmed runtime-span instrumentation is present in code; loss is post-instrumentation.

aisha: I'm going to add a temporary mute rule to Grafana alert `otel_exporter_error_rate` for 10m while we scale, to avoid paging. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Alert manager: muted alert `otel_exporter_error_rate` for 10m for team:infra (requested by aisha).

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: otel-collector -> replicas=3 namespace=observability (initiated by maria)

maria: Also changing collector config: `exporters.otlp.retry.initial_interval: 5s`, `queue.memory.size: 524288` and bumping receiver `queued` size. Will apply patch now.

deploy-bot: collector config updated, pod rolling restart in progress.

ops-bot: nginx config patch applied to ingress; keepalive and proxy_buffer_size increased.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: otel-collector replicas=3, all pods ready.

aisha: Early signal: exporter failures dropped to ~0.5% and `otel_exporter_queue_length` back to nominal. Traceparent propagation restored for sampled requests we checked. Runtime span loss now ~<2% in the baseline trace set. :party-parrot:

frank: Followups we should file:
- add an e2e replay harness that simulates 10k concurrent requests including `traceparent` header to validate gateway under export backpressure (filed as ENGINFRA-4327)
- add CI check to ensure proxies preserve trace headers on retry
- add an alert that fires on sustained queue_length > threshold for > 2m and differentiates by zone

liam: I'll own the replay harness and the CI proxy test. aisha/maria can own the Grafana panels and alert runbooks.

aisha: Thanks all. Saving logs/queries snippets to the incident doc. We'll keep this thread pinned to the incident.

frank: Note: cost impact of scaling collector is primarily CPU; estimate < $100/day for the temporary bump. We'll revert to autoscaling once gateway config and collector queueing are tuned.

maria: closing loop: will follow up with a small PR to the ingress helm chart to set `proxy_preserve_headers: true` and add a note about trace header retention in the README.

liam: Thanks — closing on my side once replay harness PR lands.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated — monitoring for 6h.
